display_long_description:
Now—flip it!
Miss the timing, and your bungeoppang is ruined.

Flip & Bake is a fast-paced VR cooking game inspired by Korea’s iconic street snack, bungeoppang.
This isn’t about recipes—it’s about timing, rhythm, and quick decisions.

Pour batter onto the hot mold,
squeeze in your favorite filling from above,
cover it with more batter, then—
flip the mold at the exact right moment.

⏱️ Timing Is Everything

Each bungeoppang must be flipped twice to cook properly

Flip too early, and it’s undercooked

Flip too late, and it burns

When steam rises from the mold, it’s your signal to act

🔥 Manage Up to 10 Molds at Once

Multiple molds cook simultaneously

Decide which one to flip first—every second counts

Your hands are busy, and your focus matters

🍡 Different Fillings, Different Scores

Choose from a variety of fillings

Cooking results affect your score

Perfectly cooked bungeoppang earns bonus points

🏆 Beat Your Best

Check your score at the end of each run

Compare with your personal best and the leaderboard

One more round is never enough

Flip & Bake is easy to pick up, but hard to master.
With simple controls and short sessions, it’s perfect for quick play—
yet finding the perfect flip timing will keep you coming back.

Get ready.
Flip at the right moment—and bake it perfectly.
